name: action-parity
description: Open standard and validator for one action across GUI, CLI, MCP, automation, and AI, with the ShadowCore cross-device profile that lets agents verify software without pixels.

scripts.check: npm test && npm run validate && npm run check:links && npm run check:public-pilot
